about: Thresholds for `bench.py accept PKG LABEL BASELINE` (see report.py). The default holds for every package: each cell no worse than the baseline's same cell on every metric below, within the baseline's band (results/BASELINE.band.json, else bench.TOLERANCE; cpu_s_per_min and peak_mb within bench.RELATIVE), plus the rules in "always". A package adds its own rules: {"metric", "where": {field: value or [values]}, one of at_most, at_least, at_most_plus, at_most_times, equals}.
